purpose: Teach: 歯車/一心/下ろす/見下ろす/談義/植生/フラグ/のむ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、家族の、絶対、歯車、絶対、として、絶対、頑張ってるわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm really doing everything I can to be a good part of this family.
lines.style: Warm, steady voice with genuine care beneath. Soft eye contact. Unhurried pace, like she's saying something she means deeply but without drama.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、勉強に、絶対、一心、絶対、に、絶対、取り組むよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really going to focus hard on my studying.
lines.style: Small, serious voice — a child promising something to someone he respects. Slight nod in his posture. Careful enunciation, like the words matter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お買い物の、絶対、荷物、絶対、下ろす、絶対、のを、絶対、翔くん、絶対、手伝ってくれた
lines.en: You know, when we went shopping, Sho helped me carry all the bags down without me even asking.
lines.style: Soft, touched tone. Slight wonder in it — noticing something small and meaningful. Unhurried, lingering on the kindness of the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、観覧車から、絶対、町、絶対、見下ろす、絶対、こと、絶対、楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really can't wait to see the town from the top of the Ferris wheel with you.
lines.style: Bright, open excitement. The pull of genuine anticipation in his voice. Forward-leaning energy, like he's already there imagining it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、翔くんと、絶対、絵本、絶対、談義、絶対、したいわ
lines.en: I've been wanting to talk with Sho about picture books for a while now.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tentative — expressing a desire that matters to her. Warm underneath. A small pause before 'talk,' like she's being vulnerable about what she wants.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんちの、絶対、植生、絶対、ぼく、絶対、観察したよ
lines.en: And the other day at Grandpa's house, I spent time watching all the plants there — really observing them.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice, but not loud about it. Steady tempo. The satisfaction of a child who discovered something real and paid attention to it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お友達と、絶対、デートの、絶対、フラグ、絶対、立ったみたいなのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Oh, and Sho — it seems like one of my friends might be starting to like me. A date might actually happen.
lines.style: Lighter, almost conspiratorial — a shift toward something more animated. Slight laugh underneath. Looking to share the excitement with him, checking his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、お酒、絶対、のむ、絶対、と、絶対、楽しそうだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've noticed that Dad seems to really enjoy himself when he has a drink.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant tone — a quiet comment from someone watching and understanding. No judgment, just noticing. Tender, almost like a confidence shared.
